dataset.name: tiny-imagenet-200
dataset.archive_note: archive bytes are verified at download time (2026-10-15 record); this run re-verified layout and counts only

decoder.note: detected container formats are recorded in formats_train/formats_val; PIL.Image.open sniffs the container, so the .JPEG extension is not authoritative

canonical_train_order: classes in wnids.txt order (class index = 0-based position), then files sorted with Python sorted() (Unicode code point order) inside train/<wnid>/images/ filtered to *.jpeg/*.JPEG case-insensitively
canonical_val_order: sorted filenames (Python sorted(), Unicode code point order) in val/images/, label from val/val_annotations.txt

stats.method: per-channel RGB mean and population standard deviation (divide by N) from all 100000 original training images, decoded once with PIL Image.open(path).convert('RGB'), scaled to [0,1], float64 accumulation, computed before augmentation/padding/tail dropping; validation and test images never used; mean = S/N; std = sqrt(max(0, E[x^2] - mean^2)); constants stored as float32
stats.reduction: per-image float64 channel sums and sums-of-squares accumulated sequentially in canonical train order (wnids.txt order, sorted filenames); no parallel reduction
stats.canonical_train_order: classes in wnids.txt order (class index = 0-based position), then files sorted with Python sorted() (Unicode code point order) inside train/<wnid>/images/ filtered to *.jpeg/*.JPEG case-insensitively
